invests.text: PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 7.4S 75.4E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 7.4S 76.0E, APPROXIMATELY 209 NM EAST OF DIEGO GARCIA. ANIMATED MULTISPECTRAL SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS AN ELONGATED, YET STEADILY CONSOLIDATING, LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER EMBEDDED WITHIN PERSISTENT CONVECTION. ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS REVEALS A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH A WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURE (SST) OF 29-30 C, LOW TO MODERATE VERTICAL WIND SHEAR OF 15-20 KTS AND GOOD EQUATORWARD OUTFLOW. GLOBAL MODELS ARE IN AGREEANCE WITH 98S TRACKING SOUTHWARD WITH STEADY DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT 24-48 HOURS. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 18 TO 23 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1009 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS IS UPGRADED TO MEDIUM.
